===== C:\Users\Mohamad\Desktop\VNEXTInternshipCRM\src\Plugins\VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins\PluginBase.cs =====
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk.Extensions;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk.PluginTelemetry;
using System;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.ServiceModel;

namespace VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Base class for all plug-in classes.
    /// Plugin development guide: https://docs.microsoft.com/powerapps/developer/common-data-service/plug-ins
    /// Best practices and guidance: https://docs.microsoft.com/powerapps/developer/common-data-service/best-practices/business-logic/
    /// </summary>
    public abstract class PluginBase : IPlugin
    {
        protected string PluginClassName { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="PluginBase"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="pluginClassName">The <see cref="Type"/> of the plugin class.</param>
        internal PluginBase(Type pluginClassName)
        {
            PluginClassName = pluginClassName.ToString();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Main entry point for he business logic that the plug-in is to execute.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="serviceProvider">The service provider.</param>
        /// <remarks>
        /// </remarks>
        [System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessage("Microsoft.Globalization", "CA1303:Do not pass literals as localized parameters", Justification = "Execute")]
        public void Execute(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
        {
            if (serviceProvider == null)
            {
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(nameof(serviceProvider));
            }

            // Construct the local plug-in context.
            var localPluginContext = new LocalPluginContext(serviceProvider);

            localPluginContext.Trace($"Entered {PluginClassName}.Execute() " +
                $"Correlation Id: {localPluginContext.PluginExecutionContext.CorrelationId}, " +
                $"Initiating User: {localPluginContext.PluginExecutionContext.InitiatingUserId}");

            try
            {
                // Invoke the custom implementation
                ExecuteDataversePlugin(localPluginContext);

                // Now exit - if the derived plugin has incorrectly registered overlapping event registrations, guard against multiple executions.
                return;
            }
            catch (FaultException<OrganizationServiceFault> orgServiceFault)
            {
                localPluginContext.Trace($"Exception: {orgServiceFault.ToString()}");

                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException($"OrganizationServiceFault: {orgServiceFault.Message}", orgServiceFault);
            }
            finally
            {
                localPluginContext.Trace($"Exiting {PluginClassName}.Execute()");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Placeholder for a custom plug-in implementation.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="localPluginContext">Context for the current plug-in.</param>
        protected virtual void ExecuteDataversePlugin(ILocalPluginContext localPluginContext)
        {
            // Do nothing.
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// This interface provides an abstraction on top of IServiceProvider for commonly used PowerPlatform Dataverse Plugin development constructs
    /// </summary>
    public interface ILocalPluginContext
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// The PowerPlatform Dataverse organization service for the Current Executing user.
        /// </summary>
        IOrganizationService InitiatingUserService { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// The PowerPlatform Dataverse organization service for the Account that was registered to run this plugin, This could be the same user as InitiatingUserService.
        /// </summary>
        IOrganizationService PluginUserService { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// IPluginExecutionContext contains information that describes the run-time environment in which the plug-in executes, information related to the execution pipeline, and entity business information.
        /// </summary>
        IPluginExecutionContext PluginExecutionContext { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Synchronous registered plug-ins can post the execution context to the Microsoft Azure Service Bus. <br/>
        /// It is through this notification service that synchronous plug-ins can send brokered messages to the Microsoft Azure Service Bus.
        /// </summary>
        IServiceEndpointNotificationService NotificationService { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Provides logging run-time trace information for plug-ins.
        /// </summary>
        ITracingService TracingService { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// General Service Provide for things not accounted for in the base class.
        /// </summary>
        IServiceProvider ServiceProvider { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// OrganizationService Factory for creating connection for other then current user and system.
        /// </summary>
        IOrganizationServiceFactory OrgSvcFactory { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// ILogger for this plugin.
        /// </summary>
        ILogger Logger { get;  }

        /// <summary>
        /// Writes a trace message to the trace log.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="message">Message name to trace.</param>
        void Trace(string message, [CallerMemberName] string method = null);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Plug-in context object.
    /// </summary>
    public class LocalPluginContext : ILocalPluginContext
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// The PowerPlatform Dataverse organization service for the Current Executing user.
        /// </summary>
        public IOrganizationService InitiatingUserService { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// The PowerPlatform Dataverse organization service for the Account that was registered to run this plugin, This could be the same user as InitiatingUserService.
        /// </summary>
        public IOrganizationService PluginUserService { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// IPluginExecutionContext contains information that describes the run-time environment in which the plug-in executes, information related to the execution pipeline, and entity business information.
        /// </summary>
        public IPluginExecutionContext PluginExecutionContext { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Synchronous registered plug-ins can post the execution context to the Microsoft Azure Service Bus. <br/>
        /// It is through this notification service that synchronous plug-ins can send brokered messages to the Microsoft Azure Service Bus.
        /// </summary>
        public IServiceEndpointNotificationService NotificationService { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Provides logging run-time trace information for plug-ins.
        /// </summary>
        public ITracingService TracingService { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// General Service Provider for things not accounted for in the base class.
        /// </summary>
        public IServiceProvider ServiceProvider { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// OrganizationService Factory for creating connection for other then current user and system.
        /// </summary>
        public IOrganizationServiceFactory OrgSvcFactory { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// ILogger for this plugin.
        /// </summary>
        public ILogger Logger { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Helper object that stores the services available in this plug-in.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="serviceProvider"></param>
        public LocalPluginContext(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
        {
            if (serviceProvider == null)
            {
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(nameof(serviceProvider));
            }

            ServiceProvider = serviceProvider;

            Logger = serviceProvider.Get<ILogger>();

            PluginExecutionContext = serviceProvider.Get<IPluginExecutionContext>();

            TracingService = new LocalTracingService(serviceProvider);

            NotificationService = serviceProvider.Get<IServiceEndpointNotificationService>();

            OrgSvcFactory = serviceProvider.Get<IOrganizationServiceFactory>();

            PluginUserService = serviceProvider.GetOrganizationService(PluginExecutionContext.UserId); // User that the plugin is registered to run as, Could be same as current user.

            InitiatingUserService = serviceProvider.GetOrganizationService(PluginExecutionContext.InitiatingUserId); //User who's action called the plugin.

        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Writes a trace message to the trace log.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="message">Message name to trace.</param>
        public void Trace(string message, [CallerMemberName] string method = null)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message) || TracingService == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            if (method != null)
                TracingService.Trace($"[{method}] - {message}");
            else
                TracingService.Trace($"{message}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Specialized ITracingService implementation that prefixes all traced messages with a time delta for Plugin performance diagnostics
    /// </summary>
    public class LocalTracingService : ITracingService
    {
        private readonly ITracingService _tracingService;

        private DateTime _previousTraceTime;

        public LocalTracingService(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
        {
            DateTime utcNow = DateTime.UtcNow;

            var context = (IExecutionContext)serviceProvider.GetService(typeof(IExecutionContext));

            DateTime initialTimestamp = context.OperationCreatedOn;

            if (initialTimestamp > utcNow)
            {
                initialTimestamp = utcNow;
            }

            _tracingService = (ITracingService)serviceProvider.GetService(typeof(ITracingService));

            _previousTraceTime = initialTimestamp;
        }

        public void Trace(string message, params object[] args)
        {
            var utcNow = DateTime.UtcNow;

            // The duration since the last trace.
            var deltaMilliseconds = utcNow.Subtract(_previousTraceTime).TotalMilliseconds;

            try
            {

                if (args == null || args.Length == 0)
                    _tracingService.Trace($"[+{deltaMilliseconds:N0}ms] - {message}");
                else
                    _tracingService.Trace($"[+{deltaMilliseconds:N0}ms] - {string.Format(message, args)}");
            }
            catch (FormatException ex)
            {
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException($"Failed to write trace message due to error {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
            _previousTraceTime = utcNow;
        }
    }
}

===== C:\Users\Mohamad\Desktop\VNEXTInternshipCRM\src\Plugins\VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins\Common\Context\PluginExecutionContext.cs =====
using System;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk;

namespace VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins.Common.Context
{
    public sealed class PluginExecutionContext
    {
        public IPluginExecutionContext Context { get; }

        // Operations performed with the actual initiating user's permissions.
        public IOrganizationService Service { get; }

        // Identity configured on the plug-in registration.
        public IOrganizationService PluginUserService { get; }

        public IOrganizationServiceFactory ServiceFactory { get; }

        public ITracingService Tracing { get; }

        public Guid InitiatingUserId => Context.InitiatingUserId;

        public Guid PluginUserId => Context.UserId;

        public Guid CorrelationId => Context.CorrelationId;

        public bool IsInTransaction => Context.IsInTransaction;

        public PluginExecutionContext(ILocalPluginContext localContext)
        {
            if (localContext == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(localContext));

            Context = localContext.PluginExecutionContext;
            Service = localContext.InitiatingUserService;
            PluginUserService = localContext.PluginUserService;
            ServiceFactory = localContext.OrgSvcFactory;
            Tracing = localContext.TracingService;

            if (Context == null)
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    "Dataverse execution context is unavailable.");

            if (Service == null)
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    "Initiating user service is unavailable.");

            if (ServiceFactory == null)
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    "Organization service factory is unavailable.");

            if (Tracing == null)
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    "Tracing service is unavailable.");
        }

        public void RequireTransaction()
        {
            if (!IsInTransaction)
            {
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    "This operation must execute inside a Dataverse transaction.");
            }
        }

        public IOrganizationService CreateScopedService(Guid serviceUserId)
        {
            if (serviceUserId == Guid.Empty)
            {
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    "A valid configured service identity is required.");
            }

            return ServiceFactory.CreateOrganizationService(serviceUserId);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk.Query;
using VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins.Common.Exceptions;

namespace VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins.Common.Services
{
    public sealed class AuthorizationService
    {
        private const string SalesRepresentative = "Sales Representative";
        private const string SalesManager = "Sales Manager";

        private readonly IOrganizationService _service;

        public AuthorizationService(IOrganizationService service)
        {
            _service = service ??
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(service));
        }

        public void ValidateLeadQualification(
            Guid initiatingUserId,
            Entity lead)
        {
            if (initiatingUserId == Guid.Empty ||
                lead == null ||
                lead.LogicalName != "vn_lead")
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    "The initiating user or Lead is invalid.");
            }

            Entity caller = RetrieveUser(initiatingUserId);

            if (caller.GetAttributeValue<bool>("isdisabled"))
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    "Disabled users cannot qualify Leads.");
            }

            bool isRepresentative = HasRole(
                initiatingUserId,
                SalesRepresentative);

            bool isManager = HasRole(
                initiatingUserId,
                SalesManager);

            if (!isRepresentative && !isManager)
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    "Only Sales Representatives and Sales Managers can qualify Leads.");
            }

            EntityReference leadOwner =
                lead.GetAttributeValue<EntityReference>("ownerid");

            if (leadOwner == null ||
                leadOwner.LogicalName != "systemuser")
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    "The Lead must be owned by a user.");
            }

            Entity owner = RetrieveUser(leadOwner.Id);

            if (owner.GetAttributeValue<bool>("isdisabled"))
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    "The Lead owner is disabled.");
            }

            EntityReference callerBusinessUnit =
                caller.GetAttributeValue<EntityReference>("businessunitid");

            EntityReference ownerBusinessUnit =
                owner.GetAttributeValue<EntityReference>("businessunitid");

            if (callerBusinessUnit == null ||
                ownerBusinessUnit == null)
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    "The caller or Lead owner has no Business Unit.");
            }

            if (callerBusinessUnit.Id != ownerBusinessUnit.Id)
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    "The caller and Lead owner must belong to the same Business Unit.");
            }

            if (isRepresentative && leadOwner.Id != initiatingUserId)
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    "A Sales Representative can qualify only their own Lead.");
            }
        }

        private Entity RetrieveUser(Guid userId)
        {
            try
            {
                return _service.Retrieve(
                    "systemuser",
                    userId,
                    new ColumnSet(
                        "businessunitid",
                        "isdisabled"));
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    "The user could not be verified.");
            }
        }

        private bool HasRole(Guid userId, string roleName)
        {
            var query = new QueryExpression("role")
            {
                ColumnSet = new ColumnSet("name")
            };

            LinkEntity userRoles = query.AddLink(
                "systemuserroles",
                "roleid",
                "roleid",
                JoinOperator.Inner);

            userRoles.LinkCriteria.AddCondition(
                "systemuserid",
                ConditionOperator.Equal,
                userId);

            query.Criteria.AddCondition(
                "name",
                ConditionOperator.Equal,
                roleName);

            return _service.RetrieveMultiple(query).Entities.Count > 0;
        }
    }
}

using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk.Messages;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk.Query;
using System;

namespace VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins.Common.Services
{
    public sealed class DataverseRepository
    {
        private readonly IOrganizationService _service;

        public DataverseRepository(IOrganizationService service)
        {
            _service = service ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(service));
        }

        public Entity Retrieve(
            string logicalName,
            Guid id,
            params string[] columns)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(logicalName))
                throw new ArgumentException(
                    "Entity logical name is required.",
                    nameof(logicalName));

            if (id == Guid.Empty)
                throw new ArgumentException(
                    "Record ID cannot be empty.",
                    nameof(id));

            return _service.Retrieve(
                logicalName,
                id,
                new ColumnSet(columns));
        }

        public Guid Create(Entity entity)
        {
            if (entity == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(entity));

            return _service.Create(entity);
        }

        public void Update(Entity entity)
        {
            if (entity == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(entity));

            _service.Update(entity);
        }

        public void UpdateIfRowVersionMatches(Entity entity)
        {
            if (entity == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(entity));

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entity.RowVersion))
            {
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    "A RowVersion is required for this update.");
            }

            var request = new UpdateRequest
            {
                Target = entity,
                ConcurrencyBehavior = ConcurrencyBehavior.IfRowVersionMatches
            };

            _service.Execute(request);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk.Messages;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk.Query;

namespace VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins.Common.Services
{
    public sealed class DataverseService
    {
        private readonly IOrganizationService _service;

        public DataverseService(IOrganizationService service)
        {
            _service = service ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(service));
        }

        public Entity Retrieve(
            string logicalName,
            Guid id,
            params string[] columns)
        {
            return _service.Retrieve(
                logicalName,
                id,
                new ColumnSet(columns));
        }

        public Guid Create(Entity entity)
        {
            return _service.Create(entity);
        }

        public void Update(Entity entity)
        {
            _service.Update(entity);
        }

        public EntityReference RetrieveBaseCurrency()
        {
            var query = new QueryExpression("organization")
            {
                ColumnSet = new ColumnSet("basecurrencyid"),
                TopCount = 1
            };

            EntityCollection organizations =
                _service.RetrieveMultiple(query);

            if (organizations.Entities.Count == 0)
            {
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    "CRM009: The organization base currency could not be retrieved.");
            }

            EntityReference currency =
                organizations.Entities[0]
                    .GetAttributeValue<EntityReference>("basecurrencyid");

            if (currency == null)
            {
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    "CRM009: The organization has no configured base currency.");
            }

            return currency;
        }

        public void UpdateIfRowVersionMatches(Entity entity)
        {
            if (entity == null ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entity.RowVersion))
            {
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    "CRM021: A valid RowVersion is required.");
            }

            var request = new UpdateRequest
            {
                Target = entity,
                ConcurrencyBehavior = ConcurrencyBehavior.IfRowVersionMatches
            };

            _service.Execute(request);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Net.Mail;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk;
using VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins.Common.Exceptions;

namespace VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins.Common.Validation
{
    public static class LeadQualificationValidator
    {
        public static void Validate(Entity lead)
        {
            if (lead == null || lead.LogicalName != "vn_lead")
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM001",
                    "The requested Lead could not be found.");
            }

            int state = lead.GetAttributeValue<OptionSetValue>("statecode")?.Value ?? -1;
            int status = lead.GetAttributeValue<OptionSetValue>("statuscode")?.Value ?? -1;

            if (state != 0)
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM005",
                    "Only an active Lead can be qualified.");
            }

            if (status != 100000001)
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM002",
                    "The Lead must be in the Contacted status before qualification.");
            }

            RequireText(lead, "vn_companyname", "Company Name");
            RequireText(lead, "vn_lastname", "Last Name");
            RequireText(lead, "vn_need", "Need");
            RequireText(lead, "vn_nextstep", "Next Step");

            if (!lead.Contains("vn_nextfollowupdate"))
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM002",
                    "Next Follow-up Date is required.");
            }

            string email = lead.GetAttributeValue<string>("vn_email");
            string phone = lead.GetAttributeValue<string>("vn_phone");

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(email) &&
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(phone))
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM002",
                    "At least one contact method is required.");
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(email))
            {
                try
                {
                    var address = new MailAddress(email);

                    if (!string.Equals(
                        address.Address,
                        email.Trim(),
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        throw new FormatException();
                    }
                }
                catch (FormatException)
                {
                    throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                        "CRM002",
                        "The Lead email address is invalid.");
                }
            }

            Money budget = lead.GetAttributeValue<Money>("vn_budget");

            if (budget != null && budget.Value < 0)
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM002",
                    "Lead Budget cannot be negative.");
            }
        }

        private static void RequireText(
            Entity entity,
            string attribute,
            string label)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                entity.GetAttributeValue<string>(attribute)))
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM002",
                    label + " is required for qualification.");
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk;

namespace VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins.Common.Validation
{
    public static class PluginValidator
    {
        public static T RequireInput<T>(
            IPluginExecutionContext context,
            string parameterName)
        {
            if (context == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parameterName))
                throw new ArgumentException(
                    "Parameter name cannot be empty.",
                    nameof(parameterName));

            if (!context.InputParameters.Contains(parameterName))
            {
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    $"Required parameter '{parameterName}' is missing.");
            }

            object value = context.InputParameters[parameterName];

            if (!(value is T))
            {
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    $"Parameter '{parameterName}' has an invalid type. " +
                    $"Expected {typeof(T).Name}.");
            }

            return (T)value;
        }

        public static void RequireNonEmptyString(
            string value,
            string parameterName)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
            {
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    $"'{parameterName}' cannot be empty.");
            }
        }
    }
}

===== C:\Users\Mohamad\Desktop\VNEXTInternshipCRM\src\Plugins\VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins\Infrastructure\CrmPluginBase.cs =====
using System;
using VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins.Common.Context;

namespace VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins.Infrastructure
{
    public abstract class CrmPluginBase : PluginBase
    {
        protected CrmPluginBase(Type pluginType)
            : base(pluginType)
        {
        }

        protected override void ExecuteDataversePlugin(
            ILocalPluginContext localContext)
        {
            if (localContext == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(localContext));

            var context = new PluginExecutionContext(localContext);

            context.Tracing.Trace(
                "Executing {0}. CorrelationId: {1}. InitiatingUser: {2}. PluginUser: {3}.",
                PluginClassName,
                context.CorrelationId,
                context.InitiatingUserId,
                context.PluginUserId);

            Execute(context);
        }

        protected abstract void Execute(
            PluginExecutionContext context);
    }
}

===== C:\Users\Mohamad\Desktop\VNEXTInternshipCRM\src\Plugins\VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins\Lead\QualifyLeadPlugin.cs =====

using System;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk;
using VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins.Common.Context;
using VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins.Common.Exceptions;
using VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins.Common.Services;
using VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins.Common.Validation;
using VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins.Infrastructure;

namespace VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins.Lead
{
    public sealed class QualifyLeadPlugin : CrmPluginBase
    {
        private const int LeadQualified = 100000002;
        private const int OpportunityQualifyStage = 100000000;
        private const int AccountProspect = 100000000;

        public QualifyLeadPlugin(
            string unsecureConfiguration,
            string secureConfiguration)
            : base(typeof(QualifyLeadPlugin))
        {
        }

        protected override void Execute(PluginExecutionContext context)
        {
            context.RequireTransaction();

            var service = new DataverseService(context.Service);

            EntityReference target =
                PluginValidator.RequireInput<EntityReference>(
                    context.Context,
                    "Target");

            if (target.LogicalName != "vn_lead" ||
                target.Id == Guid.Empty)
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM001",
                    "Target must reference a valid Lead.");
            }

            string expectedRowVersion =
                PluginValidator.RequireInput<string>(
                    context.Context,
                    "ExpectedRowVersion");

            string opportunityName =
                PluginValidator.RequireInput<string>(
                    context.Context,
                    "OpportunityName");

            DateTime expectedCloseDate =
                PluginValidator.RequireInput<DateTime>(
                    context.Context,
                    "ExpectedCloseDate");

            PluginValidator.RequireNonEmptyString(
                expectedRowVersion,
                "ExpectedRowVersion");

            PluginValidator.RequireNonEmptyString(
                opportunityName,
                "OpportunityName");

            opportunityName = opportunityName.Trim();

            if (opportunityName.Length > 200)
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM002",
                    "Opportunity Name cannot exceed 200 characters.");
            }

            if (expectedCloseDate.Date < DateTime.UtcNow.Date)
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM002",
                    "Expected Close Date cannot be earlier than the current UTC date.");
            }

            Guid? existingAccountId =
                ReadOptionalGuid("ExistingAccountId", context);

            Guid? existingContactId =
                ReadOptionalGuid("ExistingContactId", context);

            if (existingContactId.HasValue &&
                !existingAccountId.HasValue)
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    "An Existing Contact requires an Existing Account.");
            }

            Entity lead = service.Retrieve(
                "vn_lead",
                target.Id,
                "vn_name",
                "vn_firstname",
                "vn_lastname",
                "vn_companyname",
                "vn_email",
                "vn_phone",
                "vn_need",
                "vn_nextstep",
                "vn_nextfollowupdate",
                "vn_budget",
                "ownerid",
                "statecode",
                "statuscode",
                "vn_account",
                "vn_contact",
                "vn_opportunity",
                "vn_qualifiedon");

            var authorization =
                new AuthorizationService(context.Service);

            authorization.ValidateLeadQualification(
                context.Context.InitiatingUserId,
                lead);

            if (IsAlreadyQualified(lead))
            {
                ReturnExistingQualification(lead, context);
                return;
            }

            if (!string.Equals(
                lead.RowVersion,
                expectedRowVersion,
                StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM021",
                    "The Lead has changed. Refresh it and retry qualification.");
            }

            LeadQualificationValidator.Validate(lead);

            EntityReference owner =
                lead.GetAttributeValue<EntityReference>("ownerid");

            if (owner == null)
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM002",
                    "The Lead must have an owner before qualification.");
            }

            Entity account;
            bool createdAccount = false;

            if (existingAccountId.HasValue)
            {
                account = service.Retrieve(
                    "account",
                    existingAccountId.Value,
                    "name",
                    "statecode",
                    "ownerid",
                    "primarycontactid");

                EnsureActive(account, "Account");
            }
            else
            {
                account = CreateAccount(lead, owner);
                account.Id = service.Create(account);
                createdAccount = true;
            }

            Entity contact;
            bool createdContact = false;

            if (existingContactId.HasValue)
            {
                contact = service.Retrieve(
                    "contact",
                    existingContactId.Value,
                    "firstname",
                    "lastname",
                    "parentcustomerid",
                    "statecode",
                    "ownerid");

                EnsureActive(contact, "Contact");

                EntityReference parent =
                    contact.GetAttributeValue<EntityReference>(
                        "parentcustomerid");

                if (parent == null ||
                    parent.LogicalName != "account" ||
                    parent.Id != account.Id)
                {
                    throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                        "CRM004",
                        "The selected Contact does not belong to the selected Account.");
                }
            }
            else
            {
                contact = CreateContact(
                    lead,
                    account.ToEntityReference(),
                    owner);

                contact.Id = service.Create(contact);
                createdContact = true;
            }

            if (createdAccount)
            {
                var accountUpdate = new Entity("account", account.Id);
                accountUpdate["primarycontactid"] =
                    contact.ToEntityReference();

                service.Update(accountUpdate);
            }

            EntityReference baseCurrency =
                service.RetrieveBaseCurrency();

            Entity opportunity = CreateOpportunity(
                opportunityName,
                expectedCloseDate,
                lead,
                account.ToEntityReference(),
                contact.ToEntityReference(),
                owner,
                baseCurrency);

            opportunity.Id = service.Create(opportunity);

            DateTime qualifiedOn = DateTime.UtcNow;

            var leadUpdate = new Entity("vn_lead", lead.Id)
            {
                RowVersion = lead.RowVersion
            };

            leadUpdate["statecode"] = new OptionSetValue(1);
            leadUpdate["statuscode"] = new OptionSetValue(LeadQualified);
            leadUpdate["vn_account"] = account.ToEntityReference();
            leadUpdate["vn_contact"] = contact.ToEntityReference();
            leadUpdate["vn_opportunity"] = opportunity.ToEntityReference();
            leadUpdate["vn_qualifiedon"] = qualifiedOn;

            service.UpdateIfRowVersionMatches(leadUpdate);

            context.Context.OutputParameters["AccountId"] = account.Id;
            context.Context.OutputParameters["ContactId"] = contact.Id;
            context.Context.OutputParameters["OpportunityId"] = opportunity.Id;
            context.Context.OutputParameters["WasAlreadyQualified"] = false;
            context.Context.OutputParameters["CorrelationId"] =
                context.Context.CorrelationId.ToString();

            context.Tracing.Trace(
                "EXT10 completed. Lead: " + lead.Id +
                ", Opportunity: " + opportunity.Id +
                ", Account created: " + createdAccount +
                ", Contact created: " + createdContact);
        }

        private static Guid? ReadOptionalGuid(
            string parameterName,
            PluginExecutionContext context)
        {
            if (!context.Context.InputParameters.Contains(parameterName))
                return null;

            object value = context.Context.InputParameters[parameterName];

            if (!(value is Guid))
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    parameterName + " must be a GUID.");
            }

            Guid id = (Guid)value;

            if (id == Guid.Empty)
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    parameterName + " cannot be empty.");
            }

            return id;
        }

        private static bool IsAlreadyQualified(Entity lead)
        {
            int state =
                lead.GetAttributeValue<OptionSetValue>("statecode")?.Value ?? -1;

            int status =
                lead.GetAttributeValue<OptionSetValue>("statuscode")?.Value ?? -1;

            return state == 1 &&
                   status == LeadQualified &&
                   lead.GetAttributeValue<EntityReference>("vn_account") != null &&
                   lead.GetAttributeValue<EntityReference>("vn_contact") != null &&
                   lead.GetAttributeValue<EntityReference>("vn_opportunity") != null;
        }

        private static void ReturnExistingQualification(
            Entity lead,
            PluginExecutionContext context)
        {
            context.Context.OutputParameters["AccountId"] =
                lead.GetAttributeValue<EntityReference>("vn_account").Id;

            context.Context.OutputParameters["ContactId"] =
                lead.GetAttributeValue<EntityReference>("vn_contact").Id;

            context.Context.OutputParameters["OpportunityId"] =
                lead.GetAttributeValue<EntityReference>("vn_opportunity").Id;

            context.Context.OutputParameters["WasAlreadyQualified"] = true;
            context.Context.OutputParameters["CorrelationId"] =
                context.Context.CorrelationId.ToString();
        }

        private static void EnsureActive(Entity entity, string label)
        {
            int state =
                entity.GetAttributeValue<OptionSetValue>("statecode")?.Value ?? -1;

            if (state != 0)
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    "The selected " + label + " must be active.");
            }
        }

        private static Entity CreateAccount(Entity lead, EntityReference owner)
        {
            var account = new Entity("account");

            account["name"] =
                lead.GetAttributeValue<string>("vn_companyname").Trim();

            account["vn_accounttype"] =
                new OptionSetValue(AccountProspect);

            CopyIfPresent(lead, account, "vn_phone", "telephone1");
            account["ownerid"] = owner;

            return account;
        }

        private static Entity CreateContact(
            Entity lead,
            EntityReference account,
            EntityReference owner)
        {
            var contact = new Entity("contact");

            string firstName =
                lead.GetAttributeValue<string>("vn_firstname");

            string email =
                lead.GetAttributeValue<string>("vn_email");

            string phone =
                lead.GetAttributeValue<string>("vn_phone");

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(firstName))
                contact["firstname"] = firstName.Trim();

            contact["lastname"] =
                lead.GetAttributeValue<string>("vn_lastname").Trim();

            contact["parentcustomerid"] = account;

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(email))
            {
                contact["emailaddress1"] = email.Trim();
                contact["vn_preferredmethod"] = new OptionSetValue(100000000);
            }
            else
            {
                contact["mobilephone"] = phone.Trim();
                contact["vn_preferredmethod"] = new OptionSetValue(100000001);
            }

            contact["ownerid"] = owner;

            return contact;
        }

        private static Entity CreateOpportunity(
            string name,
            DateTime expectedCloseDate,
            Entity lead,
            EntityReference account,
            EntityReference contact,
            EntityReference owner,
            EntityReference baseCurrency)
        {
            var opportunity = new Entity("vn_opportunity");

            DateTime now = DateTime.UtcNow;

            opportunity["vn_name"] = name;
            opportunity["vn_account"] = account;
            opportunity["vn_primarycontact"] = contact;
            opportunity["vn_originatinglead"] = lead.ToEntityReference();

            opportunity["transactioncurrencyid"] = baseCurrency;

            opportunity["vn_expectedclosedate"] = expectedCloseDate.Date;
            opportunity["vn_nextstep"] =
                lead.GetAttributeValue<string>("vn_nextstep").Trim();

            opportunity["vn_nextfollowupdate"] =
                lead.GetAttributeValue<DateTime>("vn_nextfollowupdate").Date;

            opportunity["vn_stage"] =
                new OptionSetValue(OpportunityQualifyStage);

            opportunity["vn_probability"] = 10;
            opportunity["vn_total"] = new Money(0m);
            opportunity["vn_maximumdiscount"] = 0m;
            opportunity["vn_commandsequence"] = 0;
            opportunity["vn_currentapproval"] = null;
            opportunity["vn_lastprogresson"] = now;
            opportunity["vn_stageenteredon"] = now;

            opportunity["ownerid"] = owner;

            return opportunity;
        }

        private static void CopyIfPresent(
            Entity source,
            Entity target,
            string sourceAttribute,
            string targetAttribute)
        {
            string value = source.GetAttributeValue<string>(sourceAttribute);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
                target[targetAttribute] = value.Trim();
        }
    }
}

===== C:\Users\Mohamad\Desktop\VNEXTInternshipCRM\src\Plugins\VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins\PluginBase.cs =====
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk.Extensions;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk.PluginTelemetry;
using System;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.ServiceModel;

namespace VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Base class for all plug-in classes.
    /// Plugin development guide: https://docs.microsoft.com/powerapps/developer/common-data-service/plug-ins
    /// Best practices and guidance: https://docs.microsoft.com/powerapps/developer/common-data-service/best-practices/business-logic/
    /// </summary>
    public abstract class PluginBase : IPlugin
    {
        protected string PluginClassName { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="PluginBase"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="pluginClassName">The <see cref="Type"/> of the plugin class.</param>
        internal PluginBase(Type pluginClassName)
        {
            PluginClassName = pluginClassName.ToString();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Main entry point for he business logic that the plug-in is to execute.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="serviceProvider">The service provider.</param>
        /// <remarks>
        /// </remarks>
        [System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessage("Microsoft.Globalization", "CA1303:Do not pass literals as localized parameters", Justification = "Execute")]
        public void Execute(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
        {
            if (serviceProvider == null)
            {
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(nameof(serviceProvider));
            }

            // Construct the local plug-in context.
            var localPluginContext = new LocalPluginContext(serviceProvider);

            localPluginContext.Trace($"Entered {PluginClassName}.Execute() " +
                $"Correlation Id: {localPluginContext.PluginExecutionContext.CorrelationId}, " +
                $"Initiating User: {localPluginContext.PluginExecutionContext.InitiatingUserId}");

            try
            {
                // Invoke the custom implementation
                ExecuteDataversePlugin(localPluginContext);

                // Now exit - if the derived plugin has incorrectly registered overlapping event registrations, guard against multiple executions.
                return;
            }
            catch (FaultException<OrganizationServiceFault> orgServiceFault)
            {
                localPluginContext.Trace($"Exception: {orgServiceFault.ToString()}");

                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException($"OrganizationServiceFault: {orgServiceFault.Message}", orgServiceFault);
            }
            finally
            {
                localPluginContext.Trace($"Exiting {PluginClassName}.Execute()");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Placeholder for a custom plug-in implementation.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="localPluginContext">Context for the current plug-in.</param>
        protected virtual void ExecuteDataversePlugin(ILocalPluginContext localPluginContext)
        {
            // Do nothing.
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// This interface provides an abstraction on top of IServiceProvider for commonly used PowerPlatform Dataverse Plugin development constructs
    /// </summary>
    public interface ILocalPluginContext
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// The PowerPlatform Dataverse organization service for the Current Executing user.
        /// </summary>
        IOrganizationService InitiatingUserService { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// The PowerPlatform Dataverse organization service for the Account that was registered to run this plugin, This could be the same user as InitiatingUserService.
        /// </summary>
        IOrganizationService PluginUserService { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// IPluginExecutionContext contains information that describes the run-time environment in which the plug-in executes, information related to the execution pipeline, and entity business information.
        /// </summary>
        IPluginExecutionContext PluginExecutionContext { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Synchronous registered plug-ins can post the execution context to the Microsoft Azure Service Bus. <br/>
        /// It is through this notification service that synchronous plug-ins can send brokered messages to the Microsoft Azure Service Bus.
        /// </summary>
        IServiceEndpointNotificationService NotificationService { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Provides logging run-time trace information for plug-ins.
        /// </summary>
        ITracingService TracingService { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// General Service Provide for things not accounted for in the base class.
        /// </summary>
        IServiceProvider ServiceProvider { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// OrganizationService Factory for creating connection for other then current user and system.
        /// </summary>
        IOrganizationServiceFactory OrgSvcFactory { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// ILogger for this plugin.
        /// </summary>
        ILogger Logger { get;  }

        /// <summary>
        /// Writes a trace message to the trace log.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="message">Message name to trace.</param>
        void Trace(string message, [CallerMemberName] string method = null);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Plug-in context object.
    /// </summary>
    public class LocalPluginContext : ILocalPluginContext
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// The PowerPlatform Dataverse organization service for the Current Executing user.
        /// </summary>
        public IOrganizationService InitiatingUserService { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// The PowerPlatform Dataverse organization service for the Account that was registered to run this plugin, This could be the same user as InitiatingUserService.
        /// </summary>
        public IOrganizationService PluginUserService { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// IPluginExecutionContext contains information that describes the run-time environment in which the plug-in executes, information related to the execution pipeline, and entity business information.
        /// </summary>
        public IPluginExecutionContext PluginExecutionContext { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Synchronous registered plug-ins can post the execution context to the Microsoft Azure Service Bus. <br/>
        /// It is through this notification service that synchronous plug-ins can send brokered messages to the Microsoft Azure Service Bus.
        /// </summary>
        public IServiceEndpointNotificationService NotificationService { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Provides logging run-time trace information for plug-ins.
        /// </summary>
        public ITracingService TracingService { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// General Service Provider for things not accounted for in the base class.
        /// </summary>
        public IServiceProvider ServiceProvider { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// OrganizationService Factory for creating connection for other then current user and system.
        /// </summary>
        public IOrganizationServiceFactory OrgSvcFactory { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// ILogger for this plugin.
        /// </summary>
        public ILogger Logger { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Helper object that stores the services available in this plug-in.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="serviceProvider"></param>
        public LocalPluginContext(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
        {
            if (serviceProvider == null)
            {
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(nameof(serviceProvider));
            }

            ServiceProvider = serviceProvider;

            Logger = serviceProvider.Get<ILogger>();

            PluginExecutionContext = serviceProvider.Get<IPluginExecutionContext>();

            TracingService = new LocalTracingService(serviceProvider);

            NotificationService = serviceProvider.Get<IServiceEndpointNotificationService>();

            OrgSvcFactory = serviceProvider.Get<IOrganizationServiceFactory>();

            PluginUserService = serviceProvider.GetOrganizationService(PluginExecutionContext.UserId); // User that the plugin is registered to run as, Could be same as current user.

            InitiatingUserService = serviceProvider.GetOrganizationService(PluginExecutionContext.InitiatingUserId); //User who's action called the plugin.

        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Writes a trace message to the trace log.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="message">Message name to trace.</param>
        public void Trace(string message, [CallerMemberName] string method = null)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message) || TracingService == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            if (method != null)
                TracingService.Trace($"[{method}] - {message}");
            else
                TracingService.Trace($"{message}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Specialized ITracingService implementation that prefixes all traced messages with a time delta for Plugin performance diagnostics
    /// </summary>
    public class LocalTracingService : ITracingService
    {
        private readonly ITracingService _tracingService;

        private DateTime _previousTraceTime;

        public LocalTracingService(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
        {
            DateTime utcNow = DateTime.UtcNow;

            var context = (IExecutionContext)serviceProvider.GetService(typeof(IExecutionContext));

            DateTime initialTimestamp = context.OperationCreatedOn;

            if (initialTimestamp > utcNow)
            {
                initialTimestamp = utcNow;
            }

            _tracingService = (ITracingService)serviceProvider.GetService(typeof(ITracingService));

            _previousTraceTime = initialTimestamp;
        }

        public void Trace(string message, params object[] args)
        {
            var utcNow = DateTime.UtcNow;

            // The duration since the last trace.
            var deltaMilliseconds = utcNow.Subtract(_previousTraceTime).TotalMilliseconds;

            try
            {

                if (args == null || args.Length == 0)
                    _tracingService.Trace($"[+{deltaMilliseconds:N0}ms] - {message}");
                else
                    _tracingService.Trace($"[+{deltaMilliseconds:N0}ms] - {string.Format(message, args)}");
            }
            catch (FormatException ex)
            {
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException($"Failed to write trace message due to error {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
            _previousTraceTime = utcNow;
        }
    }
}

===== C:\Users\Mohamad\Desktop\VNEXTInternshipCRM\src\Plugins\VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins\Common\Context\PluginExecutionContext.cs =====
using System;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk;

namespace VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins.Common.Context
{
    public sealed class PluginExecutionContext
    {
        public IPluginExecutionContext Context { get; }

        // Operations performed with the actual initiating user's permissions.
        public IOrganizationService Service { get; }

        // Identity configured on the plug-in registration.
        public IOrganizationService PluginUserService { get; }

        public IOrganizationServiceFactory ServiceFactory { get; }

        public ITracingService Tracing { get; }

        public Guid InitiatingUserId => Context.InitiatingUserId;

        public Guid PluginUserId => Context.UserId;

        public Guid CorrelationId => Context.CorrelationId;

        public bool IsInTransaction => Context.IsInTransaction;

        public PluginExecutionContext(ILocalPluginContext localContext)
        {
            if (localContext == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(localContext));

            Context = localContext.PluginExecutionContext;
            Service = localContext.InitiatingUserService;
            PluginUserService = localContext.PluginUserService;
            ServiceFactory = localContext.OrgSvcFactory;
            Tracing = localContext.TracingService;

            if (Context == null)
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    "Dataverse execution context is unavailable.");

            if (Service == null)
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    "Initiating user service is unavailable.");

            if (ServiceFactory == null)
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    "Organization service factory is unavailable.");

            if (Tracing == null)
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    "Tracing service is unavailable.");
        }

        public void RequireTransaction()
        {
            if (!IsInTransaction)
            {
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    "This operation must execute inside a Dataverse transaction.");
            }
        }

        public IOrganizationService CreateScopedService(Guid serviceUserId)
        {
            if (serviceUserId == Guid.Empty)
            {
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    "A valid configured service identity is required.");
            }

            return ServiceFactory.CreateOrganizationService(serviceUserId);
        }
    }
}

===== C:\Users\Mohamad\Desktop\VNEXTInternshipCRM\src\Plugins\VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins\Common\Services\AuthorizationService.cs =====

using System;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk.Query;
using VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins.Common.Exceptions;

namespace VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins.Common.Services
{
    public sealed class AuthorizationService
    {
        private const string SalesRepresentative = "Sales Representative";
        private const string SalesManager = "Sales Manager";

        private readonly IOrganizationService _service;

        public AuthorizationService(IOrganizationService service)
        {
            _service = service ??
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(service));
        }

        public void ValidateLeadQualification(
            Guid initiatingUserId,
            Entity lead)
        {
            if (initiatingUserId == Guid.Empty ||
                lead == null ||
                lead.LogicalName != "vn_lead")
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    "The initiating user or Lead is invalid.");
            }

            Entity caller = RetrieveUser(initiatingUserId);

            if (caller.GetAttributeValue<bool>("isdisabled"))
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    "Disabled users cannot qualify Leads.");
            }

            bool isRepresentative = HasRole(
                initiatingUserId,
                SalesRepresentative);

            bool isManager = HasRole(
                initiatingUserId,
                SalesManager);

            if (!isRepresentative && !isManager)
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    "Only Sales Representatives and Sales Managers can qualify Leads.");
            }

            EntityReference leadOwner =
                lead.GetAttributeValue<EntityReference>("ownerid");

            if (leadOwner == null ||
                leadOwner.LogicalName != "systemuser")
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    "The Lead must be owned by a user.");
            }

            Entity owner = RetrieveUser(leadOwner.Id);

            if (owner.GetAttributeValue<bool>("isdisabled"))
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    "The Lead owner is disabled.");
            }

            EntityReference callerBusinessUnit =
                caller.GetAttributeValue<EntityReference>("businessunitid");

            EntityReference ownerBusinessUnit =
                owner.GetAttributeValue<EntityReference>("businessunitid");

            if (callerBusinessUnit == null ||
                ownerBusinessUnit == null)
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    "The caller or Lead owner has no Business Unit.");
            }

            if (callerBusinessUnit.Id != ownerBusinessUnit.Id)
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    "The caller and Lead owner must belong to the same Business Unit.");
            }

            if (isRepresentative && leadOwner.Id != initiatingUserId)
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    "A Sales Representative can qualify only their own Lead.");
            }
        }

        private Entity RetrieveUser(Guid userId)
        {
            try
            {
                return _service.Retrieve(
                    "systemuser",
                    userId,
                    new ColumnSet(
                        "businessunitid",
                        "isdisabled"));
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                throw CrmPluginException.Create(
                    "CRM003",
                    "The user could not be verified.");
            }
        }

        private bool HasRole(Guid userId, string roleName)
        {
            var query = new QueryExpression("role")
            {
                ColumnSet = new ColumnSet("name")
            };

            LinkEntity userRoles = query.AddLink(
                "systemuserroles",
                "roleid",
                "roleid",
                JoinOperator.Inner);

            userRoles.LinkCriteria.AddCondition(
                "systemuserid",
                ConditionOperator.Equal,
                userId);

            query.Criteria.AddCondition(
                "name",
                ConditionOperator.Equal,
                roleName);

            return _service.RetrieveMultiple(query).Entities.Count > 0;
        }
    }
}

using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk.Messages;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk.Query;
using System;

namespace VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins.Common.Services
{
    public sealed class DataverseRepository
    {
        private readonly IOrganizationService _service;

        public DataverseRepository(IOrganizationService service)
        {
            _service = service ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(service));
        }

        public Entity Retrieve(
            string logicalName,
            Guid id,
            params string[] columns)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(logicalName))
                throw new ArgumentException(
                    "Entity logical name is required.",
                    nameof(logicalName));

            if (id == Guid.Empty)
                throw new ArgumentException(
                    "Record ID cannot be empty.",
                    nameof(id));

            return _service.Retrieve(
                logicalName,
                id,
                new ColumnSet(columns));
        }

        public Guid Create(Entity entity)
        {
            if (entity == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(entity));

            return _service.Create(entity);
        }

        public void Update(Entity entity)
        {
            if (entity == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(entity));

            _service.Update(entity);
        }

        public void UpdateIfRowVersionMatches(Entity entity)
        {
            if (entity == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(entity));

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entity.RowVersion))
            {
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    "A RowVersion is required for this update.");
            }

            var request = new UpdateRequest
            {
                Target = entity,
                ConcurrencyBehavior = ConcurrencyBehavior.IfRowVersionMatches
            };

            _service.Execute(request);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk.Messages;
using Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk.Query;

namespace VNEXTInternshipCRM.Plugins.Common.Services
{
    public sealed class DataverseService
    {
        private readonly IOrganizationService _service;

        public DataverseService(IOrganizationService service)
        {
            _service = service ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(service));
        }

        public Entity Retrieve(
            string logicalName,
            Guid id,
            params string[] columns)
        {
            return _service.Retrieve(
                logicalName,
                id,
                new ColumnSet(columns));
        }

        public Guid Create(Entity entity)
        {
            return _service.Create(entity);
        }

        public void Update(Entity entity)
        {
            _service.Update(entity);
        }

        public EntityReference RetrieveBaseCurrency()
        {
            var query = new QueryExpression("organization")
            {
                ColumnSet = new ColumnSet("basecurrencyid"),
                TopCount = 1
            };

            EntityCollection organizations =
                _service.RetrieveMultiple(query);

            if (organizations.Entities.Count == 0)
            {
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    "CRM009: The organization base currency could not be retrieved.");
            }

            EntityReference currency =
                organizations.Entities[0]
                    .GetAttributeValue<EntityReference>("basecurrencyid");

            if (currency == null)
            {
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    "CRM009: The organization has no configured base currency.");
            }

            return currency;
        }

        public void UpdateIfRowVersionMatches(Entity entity)
        {
            if (entity == null ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entity.RowVersion))
            {
                throw new InvalidPluginExecutionException(
                    "CRM021: A valid RowVersion is required.");
            }

            var request = new UpdateRequest
            {
                Target = entity,
                ConcurrencyBehavior = ConcurrencyBehavior.IfRowVersionMatches
            };

            _service.Execute(request);
        }
    }
}
